sources.setup: plain BDS, superflat survival world, difficulty easy; four bds-sweep-client players (Subject, Viewer, Late, Fourth); Subject stands at (0.5,-60,0.5) inside a glass tank (interior -1..1, -60..-58, -1..1) the console fills with water or air; Viewer at (3.5,-60,0.5); phases: game modes, sneak/sprint/swim/crawl input flags, a fire block at the feet over netherrack, invisibility, stone at eye height, late joins, /kill

same world and tank, one client; /gamerule changes while healing, drowning, burning, /damage per cause with its rule off and on, /kill with keepinventory, showdeathmessages and doimmediaterespawn (a slime also attacked the player)
same world and tank, one client with a fixed identity; it leaves under water and rejoins (its connection times out ten seconds after it leaves)
same world and tank, no mob spawning; leave under water, drain while away, rejoin on land; soul sand and magma under the player's feet to make bubble columns
same world and tank, no mob spawning; a diamond helmet with Respiration III, then I, moved to the head slot through the inventory screen; 90 s and 50 s dives

packets: hex of the packet header and payload (no length prefix), as recorded by client_diff

add_player_breathing.note: Viewer joining sees Subject (player index 1, game type default, breathing, air 300): 79 rows.

add_player_joining.note: Subject sees Viewer join: not breathing yet (its join state), player index 2.

add_player_late.note: Late joining sees Viewer sneaking (SNEAKING, height 1.49, second-word bits 72 and 73) and Subject, its game mode set by /gamemode survival (game type survival), eyes under water (no BREATHING, air 238) and CAN_SHOW_NAME after an invisibility.

add_player_index.note: Late gets index 3; Fourth gets index 4 although Viewer (index 2) had left a second earlier (its connection was still open until it timed out).

game_modes.note: Subject on land: creative, survival, spectator, survival, adventure, survival 2 s apart. Only spectator and back change the flag word (HAS_COLLISION), sent right after UpdatePlayerGameType.

game_modes_viewer.note: The same game-mode changes as Viewer received them.

sneak.note: Startsneaking then Stopsneaking (with Sneaking/Sneakdown held between): flags, height, old second word and key 139; the second word with bits 72|73 (73 stays after the sneak); the flags, second word and 139 again on the next tick.

sneak_viewer.note: The same sneak as Viewer received it.

fire.note: A fire block at the feet for 3 s: hurt (fire, 6), ONFIRE on; fire_tick (7) hurts while burning; ONFIRE off when the burning ends.

invisibility.note: /effect invisibility 3 s: INVISIBLE on; when it ends INVISIBLE off and CAN_SHOW_NAME on.

crawl.note: Stone at eye height for 3 s: height 0.6 with CRAWLING (second word), then 1.8 without.

kill_on_land.note: /kill on land at full air: death event, last death block (0,-59,0) and has-died, then the next tick the 0.2 x 0.2 box; after the respawn the 0.6 x 1.8 box.

kill_on_land_viewer.note: The same death as Fourth received it.

regeneration_toggle.note: /damage 10 magic at food 20: a heal every 80 ticks; naturalregeneration false stops it; true again: the next heal 80 ticks later.

drowning_damage_off.note: drowningdamage false, then 20 s under water: the air still cycles -19 -> 0 without hits; drowningdamage true: the next cycle hits.

fire_damage_off.note: firedamage false and a fire block at the feet: ONFIRE but no damage; firedamage true while still burning: fire_tick hurts again.

damage_command_rules.note: /damage 1 with each cause after its rule was turned off and on.

slime_hits.note: A slime's hits: SetActorMotion then hurt (entity_attack, 2); the killing hit sends neither, only the death event.

rejoin_under_water.note: Left at air 200 under water; its connection stayed 10 s more, so it was saved at -1. The join SetActorData still says 300; the first update is -2, then a hit at -20.

rejoin_on_land.note: Left at air 240 under water, saved at 39, the tank drained while it was away: the join says 300, the first update BREATHING with 43, then +4 a tick.

soul_sand_column.note: Water over soul sand under the feet: two ticks holding the breath, then the column reaches the feet block and the air is 300 with BREATHING at once.

fire_resistance.note: Fire resistance given: FIRE_IMMUNE in the flag word; /effect clear: it goes (the player was holding its breath in the leftover water, so the air updates around it are unrelated).

respiration_3.note: Respiration III, 90 s under water: the air drops on about 1 tick in 4; hits as usual when a drop would reach -20.

respiration_1.note: Respiration I, 50 s under water: the air drops on about 1 tick in 2.
